      source_models:
      - staging.stg_salesforce__account
      business_logic: '- Start from staging.stg_salesforce__account and keep only rows where is_deleted is false (rows with true or NULL are excluded). - Pass through fields: account_id, account_name, type → account_type, industry, annual_revenue, number_of_employees, billing_street, billing_city, billing_state, billing_postal_code, billing_country, website, owner_id. - Set unavailable fields to NULL: phone, created_date, last_modified_date. - Derive account_size_segment from annual_revenue: - >= 10,000,000 → "Enterprise" - >= 1,000,000 and < 10,000,000 → "Mid-Market" - >= 100,000 and < 1,000,000 → "SMB" - > 0 and < 100,000 → "Small" - Else (NULL or <= 0) → "Unknown" - Derive geographic_region using case-insensitive billing_country matching: - North America if in {US, USA, UNITED STATES, CANADA, CA} - Europe if in {UK, UNITED KINGDOM, FRANCE, GERMANY, SPAIN, ITALY, NETHERLANDS, BELGIUM, SWEDEN, NORWAY, DENMARK, FINLAND, IRELAND, PORTUGAL, AUSTRIA, SWITZERLAND} - Asia-Pacific if in {CHINA, JAPAN, INDIA, AUSTRALIA, SINGAPORE, SOUTH KOREA, THAILAND, MALAYSIA, INDONESIA, PHILIPPINES, VIETNAM, NEW ZEALAND} - Latin America if in {BRAZIL, MEXICO, ARGENTINA, CHILE, COLOMBIA, PERU, VENEZUELA, ECUADOR, BOLIVIA, URUGUAY, PARAGUAY} - Else (including NULL or blanks) → "Other" - Set account_age_days to NULL and account_maturity_stage to constant "Unknown" (placeholders). - industry_normalized: remove leading/trailing spaces when industry is present; - name: int_salesforce__lead_conversion_funnel
      description: Lead conversion metrics and funnel attributes derived from non-deleted Salesforce leads
      grain: One row per lead_id from non-deleted staging.stg_salesforce__lead
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_salesforce__lead
      business_logic: '- Start from staging.stg_salesforce__lead and keep only records where is_deleted is false; emit each remaining source row without aggregation or deduplication. - Pass through source attributes and derive: - lead_name: If both first_name and last_name are present, set to "first_name last_name"; if only last_name is present, set to last_name; otherwise null. Exactly one space is inserted when both are present; original casing is preserved. - lead_age_days: For converted leads, the number of days between the date part of created_date and converted_date; for non-converted leads, the number of days between the date part of created_date and the current date at execution. If a required date is missing, the result is null. Time-of-day is ignored. - conversion_time_days: For converted leads only, the number of days between the date parts of created_date and converted_date; null otherwise or when dates are missing. Time-of-day is ignored. - lead_source_category: Categorize lead_source using case-insensitive substring matches in this order: Digital if it contains web/online/social/search; Referral if it contains referral/partner/word; Marketing if it contains trade/event/conference/campaign; Direct if it contains phone/call/direct; otherwise Other. Null lead_source is treated as Other. - lead_quality_score: Integer score (0–100) computed as the sum of points: +20 for an email containing "@" and a later ".", +15 if phone or mobile_phone is present, +10 if industry is non-empty after trimming, +15 if annual_revenue is greater than 0, +10 if number_of_employees is greater than 0, +20 if lead_source equals referral, website, or partner referral (case-insensitive), and +10 if company is non-empty after trimming and does not contain test/example/demo (case-insensitive). - has_complete_conversion: True only when is_converted is true and all of converted_account_id, converted_contact_id, and converted_opportunity_id are present; otherwise false. - conversion_speed_category: For converted leads with a non-null conversion_time_days, assign Fast Track for <=7 days, Standard for <=30 days, Slow for <=90 days, and Extended for >90 days; otherwise null. - lead_temperature: Hot for scores >=80, Warm for >=60, Cool for >=40, else Cold. - Output exactly the selected pass-through and derived columns; no additional filtering or ordering is applied.'
      columns:
      - name: lead_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Unique lead identifier from source
      - name: first_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: First name from source
      - name: last_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Last name from source
      - name: lead_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Display name: ''first_name last_name'' when both are present, last_name when only last_name is present, otherwise null; preserves original casing'
      - name: company
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Company name; used in scoring after trimming and case-insensitive checks to exclude test/example/demo
      - name: email
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Email address; adds to score when it contains '@' and a later '.'
      - name: phone
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Primary phone; adds to score when present
      - name: mobile_phone
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Mobile phone; adds to score when present
      - name: lead_source
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Lead source; used for categorization and scoring with case-insensitive comparisons
      - name: status
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Lead status from source
      - name: industry
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Industry; treated as present for scoring when trimmed value is non-empty
      - name: annual_revenue
        data_type: DECIMAL(18,3)
        description: Annual revenue; adds +15 to score when greater than zero; null yields 0 points
      - name: number_of_employees
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Employee count; adds +10 to score when greater than zero; null yields 0 points
      - name: is_converted
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: Conversion flag controlling age, conversion time, completeness, and speed category
      - name: converted_date
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Conversion timestamp; date part used for age and conversion time
      - name: converted_account_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Account ID created on conversion; must be present with others for complete conversion
      - name: converted_contact_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Contact ID created on conversion; must be present with others for complete conversion
      - name: converted_opportunity_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Opportunity ID created on conversion; must be present with others for complete conversion
      - name: owner_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Lead owner ID from source
      - name: created_date
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Creation timestamp; date part used for age and conversion time
      - name: lead_age_days
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: 'Age in days: converted leads use days between created and converted dates; non-converted use days between created date and the run''s current date; null if a required date is missing; time-of-day ignored'
      - name: conversion_time_days
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Days from creation to conversion only for converted leads; null otherwise or if dates are missing; time-of-day ignored
      - name: lead_source_category
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Case-insensitive substring match with ordered precedence: Digital (web, online, social, search) > Referral (referral, partner, word) > Marketing (trade, event, conference, campaign) > Direct (phone, call, direct) > Other; null lead_source yields Other'
      - name: lead_quality_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: '0–100 integer score summed from conditions: email pattern ''@'' before ''.'', phone or mobile present, trimmed industry non-empty, annual revenue > 0, employees > 0, lead_source equals referral/website/partner referral (case-insensitive), company trimmed non-empty and does not include test/example/demo (case-insensitive)'
      - name: has_complete_conversion
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: True only when converted and all three converted IDs are present; false otherwise
      - name: conversion_speed_category
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'For converted leads with conversion_time_days: Fast Track (<=7), Standard (<=30), Slow (<=90), Extended (>90); null for non-converted or when conversion_time_days is null'
      - name: lead_temperature
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Bucket from lead_quality_score: Hot (>=80), Warm (>=60), Cool (>=40), else Cold'
